notes.title: Nice to Meet You, Steam!
notes.content:
■Introduction
Nice to Meet You, Steam!

Hello everyone! I’m Fukudanuki, the developer of Beautiful Life Show.

Thank you so much for supporting Beautiful Life Show!

Up until now, we’ve mainly been sharing development updates on social media like X (formerly Twitter) for our Japanese audience,

but with our upcoming exhibition at Tokyo Game Show (TGS) from September 25–28,

we’ve decided to start posting more regular development updates here as well.

We’re still getting used to this platform,

so we’d really appreciate your patience and warm support as we get started!

At this year’s TGS, we’ll be showcasing a playable demo at the iGi/Sofu booth in Halls 9–11 (International Exhibition Hall).

If you’re planning to attend, please feel free to stop by and give it a try!
